what: Full 21-metric PDF in one container (2 CPUs, no network, memory limit as stated), synthetic 243 MiB tenant database (1950 products, 386,250 orders, 363,900 sales, 363,900 financial rows, 118,950 ad rows; 61 days of history).
note: cgroup_peak_mib is the container's memory.peak (it includes reclaimable file cache of the database); oom is State.OOMKilled / memory.events.

equality.DashboardData: identical field by field (exact frame equality, dicts by json) for 1, 7, 30, 90 days, old code vs new code on the same database
equality.pdf: text and page count identical for 1, 7, 30 days (11 pages for 7/30; footer time masked)
equality.per_metric: title, summary and PNG sha256 of all 21 metrics identical with and without period reads for 1/7/30/90 days and two empty periods (tests/test_period_reads.py)
